errors.text_span: Across all models, performance consistently improves with the addition of more SFT data, and larger models generally achieve higher scores, with the LLaMA-2-70B model showing the highest performance in all SFT conditions.
errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly instructs to "Avoid making inferences, comparisons, or drawing conclusions about the data" and to "Avoid interpreting causes or trends". This sentence provides a summary of trends and compares performance across model sizes and training conditions, which is a direct violation of the instructions.
The description states the performance for LLaMA-2-70B with no SFT is 'about 28%'. The bar is clearly below the halfway mark between 20 and 30, at approximately 26%.
The prompt requires describing the 'tick label interval if numeric and regularly spaced'. The description omits that the y-axis has major tick marks at intervals of 10.
